answer:
Put the `space-lua` block inside a comment: a commented-out block isn't indexed and is skipped by the pages read at boot ([[CONFIG]], libraries), so it stays disabled. It will still be linted for syntax errors, though.

If you only need to diagnose a problem, you can instead add `?disableSpaceLua=1` to the space URL to stop all Space Lua scripts from loading.

Memory for: What's the cleanest way to switch off a space-lua script temporarily without deleting it?
[1] Markdown/Comment.md (Use cases)
  Scripts stay off: A `space-lua` or `space-style` block inside a comment is _not_ indexed, and the pages read at boot ([[CONFIG]], [[Library|libraries]]) skip it as well, so commenting a script out is how you disable it. / What a comment does not switch off is live evaluation in the open editor: `${...}` [[Space Lua#Expressions|expressions]] and Lua-registered [[API/codeWidget|code widgets]] inside a comment still run and render, and a commented-out `space-lua` block is still linted for syntax errors.
[2] Troubleshooting.md (Desktop)
  Disable client features: Temporarily disable a feature by appending one of these options to the space URL, for example `http://localhost:3000/?disableSpaceLua=1`: / * `?disableSync=1` disables browser offline synchronization with the Server. / * `?disableSpaceLua=1` disables loading [[Space Lua]] scripts. / * `?disableSpaceStyle=1` disables loading [[Space Style]]. / * `?disablePlugs=1` disables loading non-built-in [[Plugs]]. / Combine options with `&`, for example `?disableSpaceLua=1&disableSpaceStyle=1`. Remove the options when you finish diagnosing the problem.
[3] CHANGELOG.md (CHANGELOG)
  Edge: * Fix: while Space Lua scripts reloaded (after editing a script page), widgets on the open page could briefly fail with errors such as "attempt to index a nil value", because they rendered against a half-loaded environment. Scripts now load into a fresh environment that takes over only once all of them have run. / * Fix: index-backed views no longer refresh halfway through a queued reindex, which could temporarily hide the page being edited. / * Fix: Git sync errors caused by unrelated histories now offer a recovery action to check and combine both histories. Automatic revisions created during the connection check no longer invalidate it.
  2.11.0: * [[Space Lua]]: scripts that runs too long no longer freeze the editor: after a couple of seconds it offers to stop the script, while the rest of the app stays responsive. / * Fix: Space Lua patterns no longer mistake some non-ASCII characters for ASCII punctuation, which could corrupt page names in `string.gsub` or produce false matches. / * Fix: releasing a drag-selection on top of a link no longer navigates to it — only a real click (pointer down and up in the same spot) follows a link. / * Fix: on Safari/WebKit, selecting a word in a wrapped paragraph could highlight the entire visual line even though only the word was selected. / * Fix: a markdown table whose column happens to be named `ref`, `tag`, `tags`, `itags`, `page` or `tableref` no longer overwrites the indexed row’s own identity.
